cues.text: Start with Architecture. One unit is 30 cm, so our floor is 90 by 50 units.
Choose Rectangular Slab, and snap out the 27 by 15 metre footprint.
Wall draws the perimeter as a chain. Enter finishes it.
Nice. Two cross walls mark the north and south sides of a single central lobby.
Leave side passages in the lobby walls. All four office zones lead to this node.
Door openings need helpers. Press T on the wall base at each jamb.
Add Hole: pick the top of one helper, then the opposite base on the wall.
Good. Door fits the first opening. These are 1.8 metres wide and 2.1 high.
Select the door, then Move Copy between matching corners of the next opening.
Repeat for the entrance. Copy the component instead of drawing each door again.
For repeatable office bays, draw one short partition, leaving a shared access strip.
Move Copy repeats the partition nine metres along the floor grid.
Cool. Copy both partitions to the south office zone, using the same grid spacing.
Now a ceiling module. Zoom in and draw a 60 centimetre square on the floor.
Press T at its corner. Move the panel up the helper to the 2.7 metre wall height.
Nice. A helper at ceiling level gives the horizontal pitch for Move Copy.
For a long repeat, type 2 x39: thirty-nine more panels, two units apart.
We leave the ceiling partial so the office layout stays visible below it.
One central lobby, repeated partitions and doors, and a reusable ceiling module.
